nphi.title: CDC Caribbean and Central America Regional Office (CCAMRO)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Reference Laboratory; Council of Ministers of Health of Central America (COMISCA); Gorgas Memorial Institute; SENACYT; INDICASAT
nphi.summary: Launched in 2024 in Panama City, CDC's CCAMRO covers 21 countries, working with CARPHA, COMISCA and Panama's Gorgas Memorial Institute on early warning, surveillance, laboratory strengthening and emergency response capacity.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: CDC Central America regional office (Guatemala)
nphi.with: Ministries of health; Regional Network of National Laboratories; Universidad del Valle de Guatemala (advanced FETP); Central America FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's presence in Central America dates to the 1960s and was strengthened in 2003 with a programme office in Guatemala supporting ministries of health in seven countries on surveillance, the Regional Network of National Laboratories, FETP…

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: Regional Center of Excellence in chronic disease research (planning)
nphi.with: US National Cancer Institute; Harvard School of Public Health; Universidad Hispanoamericana; Instituto de Cancerología (Guatemala); Instituto Nacional de Cancerología (Colombia)
nphi.summary: INSP-led planning of a regional centre of excellence for cancer and diabetes research with the US NCI and Central/South American cancer institutes, including a joint mortality-database study.

nphi.title: Fiocruz/ABC human milk bank technical cooperation projects
nphi.with: Ministries of Health of Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Paraguay, Dominican Rep.; Instituto Nacional Materno Perinatal (Peru); Maternidade Lucrécia Paim (Angola); Brazilian Cooperation Agency (ABC)
nphi.summary: Series of ABC-funded Fiocruz (IFF) technical cooperation projects setting up, expanding or certifying national human milk bank networks in Latin America and Africa.

nphi.title: FOGELA – laboratory quality management toward accreditation in Central America and the Dominican Republic
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.summary: SE-COMISCA/CDC project (2012–2013) in which Gorgas took part in strengthening quality management systems of public health laboratories toward accreditation, with regional workshops held in the Dominican Republic.

nphi.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) sites
nphi.with: icddr,b (Bangladesh); Egyptian MoHP and NAMRU-3; GDD Regional Centre partners in China, Guatemala, Kenya and Thailand
nphi.summary: CDC's International Emerging Infections Program ran population-based surveillance and research on emerging infections at six sites, mostly within the GDD Regional Centers, with a Bangladesh site formalised with icddr,b in 2009.

nphi.title: Global Disease Detection (GDD) Regional Centers network
nphi.with: Host ministries of health / national public health institutes (not named on source page)
nphi.summary: CDC set up ten GDD Regional Centers between 2004 and 2013, working with host governments on outbreak detection and response, laboratory capacity, field epidemiology training and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).
